name: 53-come-at-a-body
description: Come-at-a-body: a small plump woodchuck-like critter with soft velvety golden-brown kitten fur, small round ears, a pale cream muzzle and belly, short legs and a bushy tail. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Standing in place, it puffs its fur up and spits like a cat, mouth open with its red mouth and white fangs bared and a few white flecks of spit flying from its mouth, then settles back. Same facing, same size, feet planted. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.

dash.action: A low flat-out gallop in place: the body stretched long and low to the ground, the short legs reaching out then bunching under it, the tail streaming behind. Same facing, same size, ground line. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
